mechanics.title: Head drops on death
mechanics.description: Enabled by default. Drop chance defaults to 1.0 (100%), configurable down to 0.0001.

mechanics.title: Texture caching
mechanics.description: Skin textures come from the Mojang API and are cached locally by default. A player's new skin does not show on dropped heads until the server restarts or /jph cache is run. Mojang limits repeat requests for the same profile to about one per minute, so a head may occasionally fail to generate when caching is off.

commands_and_keybinds: /jph head <playerName> [amount]: give a player head (name ignores capitalisation, amount defaults to 1)
/jph cache: clear the head texture cache
editor_notes: Command permission level not stated in the facts; presumably operator-only. Heads placed as blocks are also affected by Miniblock Merchants' player_head loot table override.
name: Just Player Heads
summary: Players drop their own head when they die, and a command can spawn any player's head. Heads use stored texture data, so they do not cause lag.
